about: Apply for or renew a licence to practise a health profession in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi FAQ page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Qualification and experience rules are set out in the unified Professional Qualification Requirements (PQR)
documents: Documents uploaded for primary-source verification by Dataflow, then further documents for the licensing department
timing: Applicants who meet the conditions are approved to enter the exam stage
channels: TAMM platform with UAE PASS or Emirates ID
Dataflow Tasheel centre in Abu Dhabi, Monday to Friday 8 am to 4 pm
